text: Create 4 new images, 16:9, all in one consistent look, using the attached character sheet AOT-CAST-SHEET as the reference for every face and outfit. Shared style for all four: anime illustration in the style of Attack on Titan (Wit Studio era), bold clean line art, heavy black ink shadows, flat cel shading, muted earthy palette of olive, slate grey, brick and dusty gold, dramatic but restrained lighting, cinematic widescreen framing, 1980s California, calm natural expressions, no text, no captions, no watermark. Location for all four: the same foggy early-morning California cemetery with weeping willows and a winding gravel path. 1) F15: insert close-up of a small hand in a black leather glove resting gently on the grey wool sleeve of a man's overcoat, the brown knit cuff of a cardigan visible under the coat, fog blurred behind, no faces. 2) F03: medium shot with the out-of-focus profile of a bearded man in a grey wool overcoat and round glasses filling the lower left foreground seen from behind-side; beyond him in focus, Alvin Cross: man about 40, inspired by Erwin Smith, tall, blond hair in a neat side part with silver-grey temples, strong angular jaw, heavy brows, blue eyes; charcoal suit, white shirt, black tie, dark overcoat; and Monica: woman early 30s, inspired by Historia Reiss, small and slender, long pale blonde hair, large blue eyes, gentle quiet face; black funeral dress under a black wool coat, black leather gloves; standing close together, both giving the foreground man a small warm smile. 3) F09: wide shot from behind of Alvin Cross and Monica (same as item 2) walking slowly away along the winding path, her arm linked through his, their backs to camera, the fog thinning ahead into pale morning light, unhurried. 4) F22: wide shot from behind of a single man walking slowly away down the winding path, the fog opening into pale gold morning light ahead: Dr. Yalom: man about 50, inspired by Zeke Yeager, short tousled dark-blond hair, full trimmed blond beard, round wire-rim glasses; grey wool overcoat over a brown knit cardigan, dark trousers; hands in his coat pockets, head slightly bowed, peaceful, no one else in frame.

Location for all six: a dim 1982 Stanford hospital radiology reading room, one wall-mounted X-ray lightbox as the only cold white light source, old film racks and a wooden desk in deep shadow. Recurring character: Alvin Cross: man mid-30s, inspired by Erwin Smith, tall, blond hair in a neat side part with silver-grey temples, strong angular jaw, heavy brows, blue eyes, commanding calm; white doctor coat with "Alvin Cross" embroidered in dark blue on the left chest, pale blue shirt, dark tie. 1) F11: medium shot of Alvin Cross standing in profile before the lightbox, one chest X-ray film clipped to it, the cold glow lighting his face from the side, concentrated and still. 2) F01: extreme close-up insert of the left chest of the crisp white doctor coat, the name "Alvin Cross" embroidered in dark blue cursive thread above the breast pocket, a pen clipped in the pocket, edge of pale blue collar and dark tie at top of frame, cold light from the left, nothing else. 3) F10: close-up, low angle looking slightly up, of the lower half of Alvin Cross's face and chest: strong angular jaw, heavy brows at the top of frame, silver-grey at the temple, the embroidered "Alvin Cross" in dark blue on the white coat, half the face in deep black shadow. 4) F05: wide shot of the room: left, Alvin Cross standing at the lightbox studying a chest film; right, in a dark corner, Jason Cross: man about 30, inspired by Eren Yeager, dark brown shoulder-length hair, intense green eyes, defiant tired stare, lean wiry build, light stubble; faded denim jacket over a grey work shirt, dusty work jeans, boots; sitting on a plain chair leaning forward with elbows on knees, a lit cigarette between two fingers, thin smoke, face half in shadow, the two brothers not looking at each other. 5) F34: insert of a single chest X-ray film clipped to the glowing lightbox, ribcage, spine and heart shadow in cold white and grey, a dense irregular pale mass in the upper right lung field, no lettering on the film. 6) F08: insert close-up of a man's rough work-worn hand on a wooden armrest, a lit cigarette between two fingers with a thin line of smoke, a chipped glass ashtray with two stubbed butts on the side table, the cuff of a faded denim jacket at the wrist, slatted light, no face.

faded denim jacket over a grey work shirt, dusty work jeans, boots; sitting alone on the edge of a paper-covered exam table, hands loosely clasped between his knees, shoulders rounded with fatigue, eyes level toward the camera. 2) F19: close-up of Jason Cross (same as item 1), a cigarette held near his mouth between two fingers with a thin curl of smoke, eyes steady and level straight at the camera, mouth closed, face half lit by slatted light and half in deep black shadow. 3) F06: medium three-shot in a narrow late-1960s suburban house hallway, warm evening lamplight, wood paneling: left, facing right, Alvin age 19: young man inspired by young Erwin Smith, neat blond side part with no grey, heavy brows, blue eyes, serious disapproving calm, tall lean build; white shirt with sleeves rolled, brown trousers; speaking quietly with one hand slightly raised palm down; right, Jason age 17: teenager inspired by young Eren Yeager, dark brown shoulder-length hair, intense green eyes, defiant stare, lean build; worn denim jacket over a white T-shirt, jeans; arms folded, jaw set; beside him half a step behind, Jason's girlfriend age 17: inspired by Ymir, tall for her age, freckles across the nose, dark hair tied back in a short ponytail, sharp wary eyes; brown leather jacket, jeans; watching Alvin; tense but still, no shouting. 4) F30: wide night shot from behind of Jason age 17 and his girlfriend (same as item 3) walking away down a quiet late-1960s suburban street under sparse streetlamps, backs to camera, he carries a heavy canvas duffel bag over one shoulder, she carries a small suitcase, parked cars and dark houses with one lit window, cool blue-grey night with warm amber lamp pools, not looking back.

Recurring character: Alvin Cross: man mid-30s, inspired by Erwin Smith, tall, blond hair in a neat side part with silver-grey temples, strong angular jaw, heavy brows, blue eyes. Recurring creature: a giant black raven, glossy blue-black feathers, heavy hooked beak, one small gleaming eye, wings spread wide, drawn with heavy ink shadow. 1) F27: wide low-angle shot inside a dark 1980s home bathroom at night, white tiles, a mirror and sink lit by one cold bulb: Alvin Cross in striped cotton pajamas, barefoot, standing frozen with arms at his sides, face turned up, eyes wide but mouth closed, not screaming; the giant black raven fills the top half of the frame descending toward him with talons open, feathers bleeding into darkness, heavy black with cold white highlights only. 2) F28: extreme close-up of the giant black raven's eye, feathers radiating from the socket, base of the hooked beak at the frame edge, one small round gleaming eye with a single cold white reflection, almost entirely black frame. 3) F29: extreme close-up of the same raven's eye, and inside the round glossy dark eye a reflection of the tiny silhouette of a man in pajamas falling backward through white tiled bathroom light, arms slightly out, a pale shape in the black iris. 4) F32: wide two-shot of a quiet 1982 Stanford office used as a therapy room, bookshelves, a tall window with warm afternoon light through half-open blinds, worn rug, side table with tissues and a lamp: left in a brown leather armchair, Dr. Yalom: man about 50, inspired by Zeke Yeager, short tousled dark-blond hair, full trimmed blond beard, round wire-rim glasses, calm intellectual face, kind tired eyes, medium build; brown knit cardigan over a shirt, dark trousers; sitting back, legs crossed, listening, hands loosely folded; right in a matching armchair facing him, Alvin Cross in a white doctor coat with "Alvin Cross" embroidered in dark blue on the left chest, pale blue shirt, dark tie, sitting upright with hands clasped on his knees, looking slightly past the doctor, guarded calm, nobody gesturing. 5) F14: close-up insert of the seated man's hands clasped tightly together on his knees, knuckles slightly pale, white doctor-coat cuffs over pale blue shirt cuffs, grey trousers, brown leather armchair, slatted afternoon light across the hands, no face.

Shared style for all five: anime illustration in the style of Attack on Titan (Wit Studio era), bold clean line art, heavy black ink shadows, flat cel shading, muted earthy palette of olive, slate grey, brick and dusty gold, dramatic but restrained lighting, cinematic widescreen framing, calm natural expressions, no text, no captions, no watermark. Recurring character: young Alvin: boy inspired by young Erwin Smith, neat blond side part, heavy brows, blue eyes, serious thoughtful face, thin build. Iron lung rule for items 2, 3 and 4: an iron lung is a long horizontal cream-painted metal cylinder tank on a wheeled frame; the patient lies ON HIS BACK fully inside the tank with only his head outside at one end, the neck passing through a soft rubber collar seal, the head resting on a padded tray, face pointing straight UP at the ceiling, with a small rectangular mirror on an arm mounted above the face; always shown in side profile. 1) F04: medium-wide shot in a 1958 rural backyard, dry grass, wooden fence, farmhouse porch, dusty gold late-afternoon light: foreground, Alvin's father, country doctor: man about 45, inspired by Grisha Yeager, long dark hair tied back, round glasses, stubble, tired kind face; brown waistcoat over a white shirt with sleeves rolled, dark trousers; kneeling on one knee beside a medium brown dog lying still on a folded grey blanket, an open leather doctor's bag beside him, one hand resting gently on the dog's side, head bowed slightly; a few steps behind, young Alvin age 9 in a plaid flannel shirt tucked into brown corduroy trousers, standing still with arms at his sides, watching, face quiet. 2) F35: wide shot of a long 1950s hospital polio ward, high windows with pale cold daylight, a row of six iron lungs along the wall per the iron lung rule, a nurse in white far down the ward; in the foreground doorway, seen from behind and small, young Alvin age 12 in a grey wool sweater over a white collar, brown corduroy trousers, standing still in the doorframe. 3) F07: medium shot in strict side profile of a single iron lung per the iron lung rule, running left to right, the patient's head outside at the left end, face pointing up, mirror above: the patient is Ralph: boy age 12, inspired by young Armin Arlert, blond bob haircut, large blue eyes, pale thin face, calm and quiet; standing at the head end beside Ralph's face and looking down at him, young Alvin age 12 in a grey wool sweater over a white collar; cold pale ward light. 4) F36: close-up in strict side profile of the head end of the iron lung per the iron lung rule: Ralph (same as item 3) lying on his back, face pointing straight up, only his head outside the tank through the rubber collar, head on the padded tray, blond bob spread on the tray, large blue eyes open and calm, the small mirror on its arm above his face catching a faint reflection of the ward. 5) F26: insert shot of a framed drawn portrait standing on a dusty dark wooden table with old newspapers at its base, slatted window light: inside the plain wooden frame, a 1950s formal portrait of Alvin's father (same as item 1) standing beside Alvin's mother, nurse: woman about 40, inspired by Carla Yeager, long dark hair tied low at the neck, gentle warm face, soft brown eyes; white 1950s nurse dress with a small white cap; both facing the viewer with calm faint smiles, shoulders touching.

Location for all six: a modest 1980s California bungalow and its living room and kitchen, venetian blinds, wooden floors. Recurring characters: Alvin Cross: man mid-30s, inspired by Erwin Smith, tall, blond hair in a neat side part with silver-grey temples, strong angular jaw, heavy brows, blue eyes, guarded calm; olive knit sweater over a collared shirt, grey trousers. Dr. Yalom: man about 50, inspired by Zeke Yeager, short tousled dark-blond hair, full trimmed blond beard, round wire-rim glasses, calm intellectual face, kind tired eyes, medium build; grey wool overcoat over a brown knit cardigan, dark trousers. 1) F17: medium two-shot at the front door, peeling paint, overgrown porch, late afternoon light: left, Dr. Yalom on the porch in three-quarter from behind-side, standing politely with hands at his sides; right, Alvin Cross in the doorway holding the door open only halfway, his body blocking the gap, a dim cluttered hallway and the edge of a newspaper stack behind him. 2) F12: wide shot of the dim living room packed with waist-high stacks of yellowed newspapers and medical journals, narrow paths between the stacks, dust in the air, slatted light through closed blinds, a buried sofa, a lamp with no shade; Dr. Yalom standing in the narrow path near the doorway, hands in his coat pockets, looking slowly around with quiet concern, not touching anything. 3) F25: insert close-up of yellowed newspapers and old medical journals bundled and tied with rough string, a thick layer of dust on top, dust motes floating in thin bars of light through blinds, headlines blurred and unreadable, heavy shadow between the bundles. 4) F18: medium two-shot in the cramped kitchen, dishes piled in the sink, newspapers on the counters, slatted light from the window over the sink: right, Alvin Cross standing with arms crossed, eyes lowered to the floor, quietly embarrassed, jaw tight; left, Dr. Yalom already half turned toward the doorway to leave, giving a small polite nod, no argument. 5) F16: medium shot in the same living room now half cleared: Molly: woman in her 50s, Hange-like practical energy, brown hair in a loose tied-back ponytail, small round glasses, warm no-nonsense face, sturdy build; beige apron over a rolled-sleeve checked shirt, work trousers; standing at the window pulling the curtains and blinds fully open with one hand, a bundle of newspapers tied with string under her other arm, strong warm sunlight pouring across the dusty floor and the remaining low stacks, dust motes glowing, her expression calm and businesslike. 6) F02: wide shot of the same living room, bright and tidy, no people: polished wooden floor, a sofa with a folded blanket, a low table with a vase of fresh white and yellow flowers, neat bookshelves, blinds fully open with warm morning sunlight flooding in, soft slatted shadows, a framed portrait on the side table, everything orderly and calm.
